_comment: Web endpoints checked by endpointMonitor. An endpoint is Down when it does not return an expected status (default 200) or does not answer within timeoutSec; an email is sent after failAfter consecutive failures and again when it recovers. Optional per entry: expectStatus (number or list), expectText (must appear in the body), timeoutSec, intervalSec, failAfter, insecureTls (accept an untrusted certificate), method.
